description: This PHP script handles troubleshooting logs retrieval for system, event, and firewall modes. It reads log entries from system commands, processes timestamps, filters by date range, and outputs logs in JSON format or as a downloadable text file. The script includes external utility files for auxiliary functions and performs permission checks.

methods.name: str2time
methods.description: Converts a timestamp string into an array with formatted time, firewall time, and UNIX timestamp, handling different date formats.
